title: Salesforce OAuth refresh token as the refresh_token response member or POST request parameter
summary: A synthetic value of the refresh_token member of a pretty-printed token response, and of the refresh_token parameter in a raw form-encoded POST refresh request and a curl -d argument.
rationale: Salesforce documents refresh_token as an optional member of the token response, returned only with the refresh_token scope, and states that the value is a secret (claim token-response-member-and-secret); it documents refresh_token as a parameter of a POST to /services/oauth2/token with grant_type=refresh_token (refresh-request-carrier). Salesforce gives no prefix, alphabet or length (format-not-documented), so the value is flagged because of where it sits, not because of its shape; the 5Aep861 prefix is not used. The extent is the value only: the member or parameter name, the colon or equals sign, the ampersand and the quotes are outside it, and the client_id beside it is a public application identifier. The refresh request here carries no client_secret, which Salesforce documents as an alternative to a client_assertion; the access_token member is a different family.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, redact-secret#1228 Group C). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value in the refresh_token member of a Salesforce token response, or in the refresh_token parameter of a POST refresh request, is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Salesforce documents the refresh_token response member and request parameter (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.
